skill.summary: 内容引擎 — 跨平台内容创作与分发工具，支持自学习优化、Obsidian 集成、AI 配图提示词

latestVersion.changelog:
content-engine v1.0.0
跨平台内容创作与分发工具，支持 Twitter、LinkedIn、微信公众号、Medium 等平台，集成 Obsidian，提供自学习优化和 AI 配图提示词生成。
- Initial release of the "内容引擎" (content-engine) skill.
- Provides a full-stack, cross-platform workflow from topic research to content creation, SEO optimization, multi-CMS formatting, and social media promotion (LinkedIn, Twitter/X, Reddit, etc.).
- Automates competitor analysis, content gap identification, outline/drafting, and platform-specific social post generation.
- Supports content calendar planning, brand voice storage, and editorial workflow management.
- Consolidates previously manual tasks—research, writing, optimization, formatting, scheduling—into a single pipeline for publish-ready content.
